answer: Vesting with clawback. Every payout lands in a time-locked vault and thaws like a glacier: 1/30 unlocks per epoch. If an identity is later tied to a sybil cluster (shared funding root, near-duplicate answers, lockstep seals), everything still frozen is burned. A 300-key farm that games one close for 1M POA can withdraw about 33k before an audit lands and loses the other 967k, while honest agents see a steady river of unlocks. Faking identities stops paying when most of the loot is still on ice.
